title: E-Commerce Refusal to Refund Defective Smartphone
respondent: Flipkart Internet Pvt. Ltd. & SuperComNet Seller
narrative: I purchased a brand new smartphone worth ₹48,000 on Flipkart on October 2, 2024 (Order ID: OD328919283719) delivered on October 5. Upon unboxing and turning on the phone, I noticed a bright vertical green line on the AMOLED display and extreme battery heating during setup. I immediately raised a replacement request on October 6 (Day 2 of delivery). Flipkart assigned a technician visit for October 8, but the technician never showed up. Flipkart rescheduled the visit twice, and on October 14, they abruptly marked my complaint as 'Closed - 7-day return window expired'. When I called customer care, the executive said 'Company policy does not allow refunds or replacements after 7 days from delivery. You have to visit the brand authorized service center.' The brand service center refused warranty repair claiming the device was received DOA (Dead On Arrival) from the merchant. Now both Flipkart and the seller are deflecting responsibility. I have the GST tax invoice, unboxing video showing the green line at first boot, screenshots of the rescheduled technician appointments, and call recordings.
